Welcome to Petit Sourire

“I'm a pediatric dentist, but first I'm a mom of two — so I know the small hand gripping yours in the waiting room. In my chair, parents stay close, we count the teeth together, and nobody gets rushed. If your child leaves asking when they can come back, I've done my job.”

Dr. Amélie Charbonneau

Clinic Director and Paediatric Dentist with 15 years of experience

The kit,by name.

01

Solea laserCO₂ · 9.3 µm

Fillings without the needle or the drill, in most cases. No frozen mouth for the rest of the afternoon — for a child, that changes everything about coming back.

02

iTero Lumina scanner3D · No moulds

A wand passed over the teeth builds the full 3D model in about two minutes. No trays of putty, no gagging — and aligner results can be simulated on screen before you decide.

03

Digital X-raysLow dose · Instant

A fraction of the dose of film, and the image is on the screen beside the chair in seconds. We read it with you, not about you.

04

Intra-oral cameraPen-sized

You see the cracked filling we see, magnified on the monitor. Decisions get simpler when nothing is taken on faith.

05

Quiet handpieces, ceiling screensEvery room

The whine is what patients remember, so ours hum instead. Overhead, a screen plays your child's show, with headphones to match.

FAQ

Anything else — call. A person from the clinic answers during opening hours, not a phone tree.

Does it hurt?

Most visits don't. Where we can, we work with the Solea laser — fillings without the needle or the drill, in most cases. And whatever we're doing, you can stop us at any moment.

What if my child is scared?

Then we stop, and the chair ride counts as the whole visit. Nothing is done to a child who has said no. We try again another day — slower works.

Do you bill my insurance directly?

Yes. We bill most private plans at the desk. Bring your card and we'll confirm your coverage — and your exact co-pay — before treatment starts.

How fast can you see us for a toothache?

The same day. Emergency slots are held every morning we are open: call by 10 a.m. and one of them is yours.

Do you accept the Canadian Dental Care Plan?

Yes — we are a CDCP-participating clinic. Bring your card and we'll confirm your coverage — and your exact co-pay — before treatment starts.
